# RSVP Status

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:RsvpStatus`](gmeow-RsvpStatus.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/RsvpStatus>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/calendar`](../../slices/calendar.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The RSVP response status as asserted by an invitee — a VALUE vocabulary, distinct from [`InvitationStatus`](gmeow-InvitationStatus.md) so that organizer and invitee claims can coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:RsvpStatus`](gmeow-RsvpStatus.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary [`gmeow:rsvpStatus`](../properties/gmeow-rsvpStatus.md) ranges over — the invitee-asserted reply states (needs-action, accepted, declined, tentative).

### Avoid when

- Avoid collapsing it into [`gmeow:InvitationStatus`](gmeow-InvitationStatus.md); the two are deliberately separate vocabularies so the organizer's view and the invitee's view can disagree without overwriting ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Reference a seeded individual ([`gmeow:rsvpStatusAccepted`](../individuals/gmeow-rsvpStatusAccepted.md), …) from [`gmeow:rsvpStatus`](../properties/gmeow-rsvpStatus.md); extend with new individuals, never [`Task`](gmeow-Task.md)/Invitation subclasses.

### Examples

- ex:standupInvite [`gmeow:rsvpStatus`](../properties/gmeow-rsvpStatus.md) [`gmeow:rsvpStatusTentative`](../individuals/gmeow-rsvpStatusTentative.md).
